title: Vinous
summary: VI'NOUS, adjective [Latin vinum, wine.] Having the qualities of wine; pertaining to wine; as a vinous taste; a vinous flavor; vinous fermentation.

inlines.v: VI'NOUS, adjective [Latin vinum, wine.] Having the qualities of wine; pertaining to wine; as a vinous taste; a vinous flavor; vinous fermentation.
